text:
emma.f: Heads-up: running a targeted pricing experiment for Enterprise prepaid customers to test a small premium for priority embeds. This only applies to customers without grandfathering=true and with prepaid_balance > 0. Need quick ops alignment on invoice tagging and credit memo rules.

raj.p: For invoices we should add invoice.metadata.experiment_id and invoice.line.note='priority premium applied'. If prepaid balance covers the premium, don't issue a credit memo; instead record an internal adjustment line.

sophia.z: Sales wants a carveout path: SFDC case tag 'enterprise-prepay-carveout'. Auto-approve if ARR < 25k USD; finance review above that. Legal sign-off if ARR > 100k. Also supply a CSV template for bulk nominations.

raj.p: Edge case: prepaid credits can lead to net_due < 0. Rule: auto-issue credit memo if abs(net_due) <= 1000 USD, else flag for manual review. We should also include prepaid_balance_snapshot on the invoice metadata.

emma.f: Success criteria: fewer than 3 customers with >12% delta, no single customer >20k USD. Rollback immediate if thresholds exceeded. Can we schedule a small canary (10 customers) Friday 09:00 PT?

billing-bot: [automated] Experiment created: enterprise_prepay_premium | cohort=enterprise_prepaid | start=2026-11-12T09:00:00-07:00 | id=exp_20261112_prepaid_premium

sophia.z: I'll publish the carveout sheet and SFDC instructions. Ops, please add monitoring for prepaid_balance_impact and invoice.metadata.experiment_id.

emma.f: Thanks all — will post final checklist and the canary list in Drive. If any red flags in the canary we'll pause and revert. :white_check_mark:
